items.reason: VerifyMessageProperties.java:74-79 newly opens the derived English bundle unconditionally and wraps a missing-file IOException in RuntimeException. That exception escapes verify(), which catches only IOException (lines 48-53), and ThemeVerifierMojo.java:48-55, aborting validation before collected diagnostics are reported. Existing bundles have English counterparts, but the file-selection path does not enforce that prerequisite, so a missing counterpart triggers the reported error-handling defect.
